$ labctl status
=== Cluster ===
  Status:   UNREACHABLE (The connection to the server 127.0.0.1:<port> was refused - did you specify the right host or port?)
  Context:  k3d-clitest
  Profile:  k3d

The cluster is configured but not answering. Usually Docker is stopped (after a
reboot) or short of memory. 'labctl doctor' checks Docker; 'labctl init' brings
the lab back without losing it.
